cobblemon.species.averi.desc2: Trainers appear to be happier when nearby this Pokémon. Some theorise it has an aura of happiness, others think it's very cute.
cobblemon.species.ryuka.desc: This prototype defence unit was designed by chance. Using DNA of a previously unknown fossil Pokémon jump started its activation in unexpected ways.
cobblemon.species.ryunit.desc: The finalized version of this anti Pokémon defence unit. Once its energy depletes, a fatal flaw in its programming causes the fossil to reawaken. It then becomes a rampaging beast likely to cause more destruction than an enraged Gyarados.
cobblemon.move.crystallinesnare.desc: The user attacks the opposing Pokémon with webs and lowers the target's Defence and Sp. Def every turn.
cobblemon.ability.materia.desc: The user's Attack and Defence are boosted by 50%. This effect ends if the user's stats change or the user receives a status effect.
